0022600091.text: The Dallas Mavericks visit the Houston Rockets as both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Mavericks a 30% chance to win. Dallas will be without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Jett Howard (illness), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), all listed as day-to-day, with Lively, Howard, and Aldama also game-time decisions. The teams split their four meetings in 2025-26, and the most recent one came on January 31, 2026, in Houston, where the Mavericks lost 111-107.
